mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE active_email = LOWER(#{email}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE users SET deleted_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
